behaviors_asserted: JWT middleware sets the context variable jwtPayload with type any.
ContextVariableMap cannot be overridden to change jwtPayload's type.
Only way to set jwtPayload type currently is by casting.
Allow specifying a generic type parameter on jwt middleware, e.g. jwt<MyPayloadType>({ secret: '123' }).
Alternatively, remove interface ContextVariableMap { jwtPayload: any; } and require users to define context variables themselves.
